text:
Type: molded shell dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: molded plastic shell, chrome-plated steel tube legs and arms, grey plastic armrest pads
Colors: white, silver chrome, dark grey
Shape: one-piece curved scoop shell with a tall rounded back, slim tubular arms with padded tops, four thin straight metal legs, light and open, compact
Feel: clean, bright, fresh, practical
Goes with: white or light wood tables, grey or pastel walls, chrome accents; modern kitchens, Scandinavian dining rooms
